checks.description: The official CWI logo is present on every shipped visual asset. Brand rule: the logo ships on everything — no asset renders without the logo badge.

Every pack ships with a mandatory truth_gate_report: status is 'pass', claims_verified has at least one entry and every entry names a fact source. Every claim inside the pack (caption, threads_text) is gated against the verified CWI fact set — no uncited claims post. A pack without a passing report is a rejected package.

Every pack validates against final-cut-schema.json (cwi-final-cut/v1): all nine standing content.json fields present (day, id, type, media_files, caption, hashtags, threads_text, post_order, platform_targets), pack_id slug pattern, semver version, truth_gate_report mandatory with status 'pass'.
DEFAULT_CONFIG + optional config.json override flow works: a config.json with orgName/productName/colors overrides the CWI defaults and produces a branded build with no unreplaced tokens.

EQUIP / CUT / POST steps are copy-paste operable: every URL referenced (pack index, schema, card, page, hub device, contact) is live, the CUT block is a truth-gated content unit, and the gate rule (status must be 'pass') is stated.

evidence.brand-token-discipline: index.html header logo, announce.html header logo — logo.jpg on both visual assets
evidence.content-schema-conformance: 4/4 launch packs pass the automated schema validation in gate 1 (all nine content fields, slug patterns, semver, enums); schema required-set matches the test contract in gate 3
evidence.give-block-operability: give-block.md EQUIP/CUT/POST reference pack index, schema, item-card, page, hype hub, hp@cumulativeweb.com — all live per gate 2
evidence.pack-truth-gate-integrity: 4/4 launch packs carry truth_gate_report with status 'pass'; every claims_verified entry names a fact source; Zooted Zone ~307K plays, New Rap Hits #21/#30/#31, Diabolique 2026-07-03 / Cue Recording Studios — all from the verified fact set; the gate refused Diabolique placement claims (correctly unverified)
evidence.white-label-config: gate 4 builds a temp config.json override (orgName/productName/colors) through build.py and confirms the overrides land in index.html with no leftover tokens
